title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: We spent a lot of time in motion on this trip because the salt flats aren’t exactly easy to get to.
It was one of the reasons we weren’t up for spending more time in a car to visit the Laguna Colorada.
As described in the itinerary, you’ll need to fly from Santa to Sucre, and then bus it to Uyuni from Sucre. Traverse the route back to check out of Bolivia.
This is a short half hour flight, but it’s not short on thrills! The small plane and strong winds will test the most ardent non-believers (including one of us). We took a flight back as well.
There are overnight buses that depart around 9:00 PM and arrive in Uyuni around 5:00 AM. There were no sleeper buses where you can lay down fully, but the recliner seats were not too shabby.
The buses don’t have air conditioning as the nights get chilly, but don’t have windows either, so ride can get stuffy. We took a bus back as well.
